transportProfile: Only route.fetch to actual upstream followed by unchanged route.fulfill or explicit abort-after-success; no canned status/body/header, no navigation interception. Requests/cookies/passwords stay memory-only; output stores safe context identities and hashes.
proofBoundaries: Existing16 plus basic17th harness untouched. This is a separate optional runner and mandatory five-case suite when invoked.

Callback final-state snapshots compare all seeded business/config/master data; auth_session compared before context-selection actors then their changes asserted separately. Intentional POST audit is separately counted.
UI/editor modifications use normal locator fill/select/click/keyboard only; no forced DOM values or local arithmetic.
Actual client-side departure covers unmount in retained document, not an unexecuted cross-process full-navigation branch.
Fixtures and every case are required; missing owner/config/controls fail rather than skip.
